open_acceptance: Legacy installed bytes do not become authenticated exact-source builds by this reconstruction.
Slipstream amd64 needs GLIBC2.34/OpenSSL3; arm64 needs GLIBC2.38. Older supported Linux distributions need compatible rebuild and execution before promotion.
Go/Rust databases do not audit picoquic/picotls/OpenSSL/C AWG, build scripts or the applied local patches.
Caddy native Chromium Naive HTTP2/HTTP3, public recursive DNS, real released phone/ARM device and long-session/network-change acceptance remain incomplete.
No GitHub release or live host engine replacement is authorized by these files.
